what: When a girihelix plan strips source-language narration from docs, the exit grep must be wider than Java|Taprats|Ported from: also match ported, "reference tree", source's, and Java camelCase method names (e.g. mergeMap). And before deleting a behavioural fact from a module doc, record it in docs/algorithm-analysis.md, especially caller fallbacks the downstream ports depend on.
why: The engine-types plan's narrow grep let four narration lines through, and deleting Intersect's zero-length note nearly lost the null-fallback that Infer/Rosette rely on; both caught only by the final review.
